from service import score

def test_make_key_consistency():
    a = make_key("x", "p1", "c1")

    a = make_key("x", "p1", "c1")
    b = make_key("x", "p1", "c2")
    c = make_key("x", "p2", "c1")
    d = make_key("y", "p1", "c1")

    assert a != c
    assert a != d

    assert calls[0] == 1
